question: What universal scope should the meditative object encompass in each location?
premises: The object is meditated upon in place after place.
Its range extends from Śiva down to Avīci.
inference: Meditation should visualize the object in every place as pervading the entire range from Śiva to Avīci.
plain_english: Having meditated on him in place after place as extending from Śiva down to Avīci...
